coverage_addIntro: Claim how deeply this material treats a topic — and, optionally, a specific subtopic within it. The same level is read both as a prerequisite requirement and as content coverage (see the hint below). The community can then discuss and vote on whether it's accurate.
coverage_levelHint: This one number is read two ways: as a REQUIREMENT (how much you should already know before this material is useful) and as WHAT IT COVERS (how thoroughly the material itself treats it).
coverage_addDuplicate: This topic/subtopic pairing is already claimed for this material — discuss or vote on the existing one instead.
coverage_verifiedWeightHint: As a verified contributor, your vote counts double.
coverage_badgeTitle: {level}/100 — both a prerequisite depth and how much the material covers

report_thanks: Thanks — this has been reported to the moderators.

auth_providers_intro: These sign-in methods are drafts. Opening one shows exactly how far it is and what is still missing.
auth_providers_schoolRunsUsos: {school} runs a USOS installation, so a connection there could confirm enrolment from the university's own registry.
auth_providers_schoolNoUsos: {school} runs no USOS installation, so a sign-in there could confirm the address but not enrolment.
auth_providers_schoolNotListed: Pick an institution to see what a connection there could confirm. Secondary schools are not listed — there are far too many — so they carry no verification.
auth_connection_draftLead: This is a draft. Nothing is connected yet, so this button cannot sign you in — here is exactly what exists and what is missing.
auth_connection_configuredLead: This provider is configured. The remaining work is the callback route itself.
auth_connection_callbackHint: Written down here because these are the parts that are easy to skip and expensive to skip — none of them is visible in a flow that otherwise appears to work.
auth_connection_repoLink: See the plan in the repository →
education_lead: Your institution, and — as a separate decision each time — how much of it anybody else can see.
education_schoolChangeWarning: Changing this clears any verification and anything transferred, because it is no longer a claim that institution made.
education_emailEligibleNote: Your address is on this institution's domain. It does not verify anything yet, because EdMat cannot confirm an address — a verification that can be earned by typing would be worth exactly as much to somebody lying.
education_usosProtocol: {protocol}. Credentials are issued per university, by that university, after a request a person there approves.
education_usosMockNote: This deployment is running the stand-in connector. It exercises the transfer and consent paths end to end, but talks to no university and verifies nobody.
education_usosPickSchoolFirst: Pick your institution first — USOS is a per-university system, not one service.
education_usosNoInstallation: {school} runs no USOS installation, so there is nothing to connect to.
education_gradesScopeMissing: Grades were not part of this authorization. They are never requested by default — reconnect and allow them explicitly.
education_consentLead: All off until you say otherwise. Transferring something never publishes it, and publishing nothing costs you nothing.
education_consentSchool: Show my institution on my profile
education_standingNoAuthority: This is a cap on what you may do, never authority over anybody else's work — that is only ever earned, never granted by identity.
education_skillSeeds: Branches on this site your registry says you passed: {count} ({branches})

course_browseEmpty: Nobody is running a course yet. You could be the first.
course_newLead: It starts as a draft, visible only to you. Publish it when it is ready.

course_yourRequestPending: Your request is waiting for the instructor.

course_visibility_publicHint: Listed in the course directory for anyone, whether or not they have an account.

course_form_capacityHint: 0 means no limit. You cannot set it below the number of people already taking part.
course_form_priceHint: Shown to people deciding whether to join. EdMat does not take payments — arrange it between yourselves.

course_attachment_discussionHint: About this file specifically — separate from the course discussion.
course_notes_privateHint: Only you can read these. Nobody running the course can see them.

course_sets_slugHint: Paste the code from the end of a shared set's address.
course_sets_copiedOn: Copied on {when}. Later changes to that set will not appear here.
course_sets_sourceGone: The original set is gone; this copy stays.
course_sets_hidden: {count} exercise(s) not shown — a moderator has withdrawn them.
course_contribute_idHint: From the item's own page URL.
course_contribute_note: Note for the people reviewing it

notifPref_bookingRequested: Somebody asks to book a session
booking_loadFailed: Couldn't load the schedule. Please try again.
booking_actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
booking_noSchedule: This tutor hasn't published any hours yet. Send them a message to arrange a time.
booking_notice_derived: These are real free hours — anything already taken has been removed, so a time shown here is a time you can have.
booking_notice_declared: These are the hours this tutor advertises. Some may already be taken — they'll confirm or decline your request.
booking_noSlotsThisWeek: Nothing free this week. Try a later one.
booking_loginToBook: Log in to book a session.
booking_noteLabel: What would you like to work on?
booking_slotGone: Somebody took that time while you were looking. Here are the times still free.
booking_requestFailed: Couldn't send that request. Please try again.
booking_requestSent: Request sent — the tutor still has to confirm it.
booking_mode_derivedHint: Your published hours, minus anything already booked or blocked. A time somebody books disappears for everybody else.
booking_mode_declaredHint: Your window keeps showing in full even once part of it is taken. Several people can ask for the same hour, and you decide between them.
booking_field_sessionMinutesHint: This is what splits your published hours into bookable times. Between 15 minutes and 8 hours.
booking_noIncoming: Nobody has asked to book a session with you yet.
booking_noneOfMine: You haven't booked any sessions yet.

booking_noRules: You haven't published any hours yet, so nobody can book you.
booking_ruleFailed: Couldn't add those hours. Check that the end is after the start.
booking_exceptionsHint: A day you're away, another appointment already in your calendar, or extra hours you're opening up just once.
booking_exceptionFailed: Couldn't add that. Check the date and times.
booking_allDayBlockOnly: Leave the times empty to block a whole day. Extra hours always need a start and an end.
booking_calendar_monthHint: Pick a day to open its week.
booking_calendar_scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see the rest of the week.
booking_calendar_legend: Shaded bands are the hours you publish. Blocks on them are sessions — amber is waiting for your answer, green is confirmed, grey is done.
settings_datesHint: These change how calendars and times are shown to you. They are separate from the interface language — reading English does not have to mean a 12-hour clock.

events_newLead: Say what it is, when it is, and where. You can save it as a draft first — nothing is announced until you publish it.
events_attendeesPrivate: Only the host and the people going can see who is coming.
events_cancelConfirm: Cancel this event? Everybody who said they were coming will be told, and this cannot be undone.
events_edit_lead: Anybody who said they are coming is told when the time or the place changes.
events_edit_notYours: Only the person running this event can change it.
events_edit_cancelled: This event was called off, and a cancelled event cannot be reopened or edited.
events_notFound: That event does not exist, or is not published.
events_form_subjectsHint: Used to show this event to people following these branches. Optional.
events_form_subjectsEmpty: No branches available for the chosen discipline.
